Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product, wherein the method is performed using a computing device.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user using a user device.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of a user identified by the second unique identifier.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for a user identified by the second unique identifier.
